# Feature: Local auth emails → @sagatree.local

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-10-13 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
Align seeded GoTrue admin/player emails with the app shortcuts (`admin@sagatree.local`, `player@sagatree.local`) so Local Admin login receives a real `authenticated` JWT and the library no longer fails with Postgres `42501 permission denied` for `anon`. Roadmap: local-stack auth hygiene (Stufe A) — brand rename follow-up.

## Preconditions
- Self-host Supabase (Kong/PostgREST/GoTrue) running with migrations through at least 074 applied historically, or fresh volume applying 001+
- App uses `LOCAL_ADMIN_EMAIL` / `LOCAL_PLAYER_EMAIL` from `src/lib/localAdmin.ts` / `src/lib/localPlayer.ts`
- Existing volumes may still have `*@sagadrive.local` auth rows from 011/074

## Happy Path
- [ ] Migration `080_rename_local_auth_emails_sagatree.sql` renames admin + player emails (and email identities) from `@sagadrive.local` → `@sagatree.local` idempotently
- [ ] Fresh-volume seeds `011` / `074` create users with `@sagatree.local` (legacy `@sagadrive.local` still found on re-apply)
- [ ] `POST /auth/v1/token` with `admin@sagatree.local` / `1234` returns JWT `role=authenticated`
- [ ] Authenticated REST `GET /rest/v1/characters?select=id&limit=1` returns HTTP 200 (not `42501`)
- [ ] Anon REST to the same table still returns `42501` (grants remain fail-closed for `anon`)

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Re-applying 080 when emails already `@sagatree.local` is a no-op (no duplicate users)
- [ ] Re-applying 011/074 finds seed UUID or legacy email and does not INSERT-conflict on fixed UUIDs
- [ ] If only identities still carry legacy email while `auth.users.email` is updated, identities are corrected

## Regression
- [ ] Player shortcut email `player@sagatree.local` matches seed after 074+080
- [ ] Static check: app emails ↔ migration emails ↔ `apply-migrations.sh` lists 080
- [ ] No widening of table GRANTs to `anon`

## Assumptions
- Only the two deterministic local seed accounts are renamed; arbitrary `@sagadrive.local` user emails (if any) are out of scope unless they match the seed UUIDs / exact seed emails
- Password remains `1234` for local shortcuts
